title: France-South Africa Scholarship Programme 2027
eligibility_summary: South African, Lesotho or Malawian citizens admitted or applying to a French higher education institution for a Master's or PhD starting September 2027. Born on or after 1 January 1996.
funding_details: Tuition fees, monthly living allowance, one round-trip airfare per year, health insurance, French language courses (Feb-Jul 2027), visa fees, and administrative support.
duration: Master's: duration of the degree (typically 2 years); PhD: up to 3 years

title: Pasteur-Paris University (PPU) International Doctoral Program 2027
provider: Institut Pasteur / Université Paris Cité / Sorbonne Université / Université Paris-Saclay
eligibility_summary: Master's degree (or equivalent) from a non-French university in science, medicine or related fields. Typically 24-26 years old. Must not have resided in France more than 12 months in the 3 years prior to the deadline. English fluency required; French not mandatory.
funding_details: 3-year salary contract, social security benefits, one round-trip travel reimbursement per academic year (up to €1,300 for non-European countries, up to €350 for continental Europe), health insurance, and structured scientific training.

title: InLife Sorbonne Université International Mobility Grants 2026-2027
provider: InLife - Initiative Sciences aux interfaces du vivant, Sorbonne Université
eligibility_summary: Master's students from foreign universities. No geographical restrictions. Interdisciplinary projects focusing on living systems. Host laboratory must be affiliated with a member institution of the Sorbonne University Alliance.
funding_details: €7,500 mobility grant covering travel and accommodation expenses, plus a statutory internship allowance applicable to second-year master's internships.

title: Sciences Po Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program 2027
eligibility_summary: Citizens of an African country (or refugee status), under 35 years of age on 1 September 2026, not already holding a Master's degree, and applying to a two-year Master's program at Sciences Po for the first time.
funding_details: Full coverage of tuition, living expenses, and comprehensive support throughout the two-year program. Includes application fee waiver for eligible candidates.
